playstyle.identity: Swain is a drain-tank battlemage who transforms into a demon form. He excels in extended fights, healing massive amounts while dealing AoE damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive pulls CC'd enemies and heals. Q fires bolts (more damage closer). W has huge range vision/damage. E sends a claw that returns, rooting. R transforms, draining nearby enemies - recast to deal damage based on health drained. Pull enemies in, R, drain to full.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Swain spikes at level 6 with his transform. Liandry's and health/AP scale him. He's strong in extended teamfights where he can drain.

passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.summary: Pull CC'd enemies toward you and heal; collect soul fragments for bonus health.
passive.details: Swain can pull immobilized enemies toward him, dealing damage. Enemies near him drop soul fragments that heal him and grant permanent bonus health.

abilities.name: Death's Hand
abilities.summary: Fire bolts that deal more damage at close range.
abilities.details: Swain fires bolts that deal damage. Hitting multiple bolts on the same enemy deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Vision of Empire
abilities.summary: Reveal and damage a distant area; slows and reveals enemies.
abilities.details: Swain reveals an area at a huge range after a delay, dealing damage to and slowing enemies inside. Also reveals them.

abilities.name: Nevermove
abilities.summary: Fire a claw that roots enemies on its return.
abilities.details: Swain fires a demonic wave that passes through enemies, then returns to him. Enemies hit on the return are rooted.

abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
abilities.summary: Transform, draining nearby enemies. Recast to deal AoE damage.
abilities.details: Swain transforms into a demon, draining health from nearby enemies over time. Recast to end early and deal damage in an area based on health drained.
